name: Ferrogate Transit
sector: Hypervelocity Ground Transit & Freight Rail Infrastructure
sovereign_territory: The Ferrogate Corridor — a 1,400-kilometer network of sovereign right-of-way strips averaging 200 meters wide, threading through the Meridian 88 megacity corridor from Milwaukee to Cleveland, including 14 fortified transit hubs designated as sovereign exchange zones
founding_story: Ferrogate was assembled between 2138 and 2143 through a series of hostile acquisitions engineered by the Szymanski-Okafor infrastructure investment group, which purchased bankrupt freight rail companies, defunct highway authorities, and two failed hyperloop startups, then fused them under a single sovereign charter when Meridian 88 corponation law was codified. The genius of the founding was territorial: by acquiring right-of-way easements before anyone understood that corridor sovereignty could be applied to linear infrastructure, Ferrogate became the only entity legally permitted to move freight and passengers at speed through the heart of the megacity. You cannot build Meridian 88 without crossing Ferrogate land.
security_force: The Ferrogate Line Authority (FLA), 18,000 officers responsible for securing 1,400 kilometers of sovereign corridor. The FLA is organized like a paramilitary railway police force and is notorious for its shoot-on-sight policy regarding unauthorized track access. Ferrogate also operates 200 autonomous patrol vehicles designated Rail Hounds that run continuous sweeps of the line at speeds up to 280 km/h.
key_detail: Every corponation in Meridian 88 that moves physical goods — which is all of them — pays Ferrogate a transit toll. These tolls are structured as sovereign transit tariffs and are non-negotiable. Ferrogate has never lost an arbitration dispute over its tariff schedule. The prevailing theory among legal scholars is that the arbitration panels are aware that Ferrogate could simply decline to move anyone's cargo.
relationship_to_big_20: Full Big 20 member, considered infrastructure-critical and therefore politically untouchable. Maintains a deliberately neutral public posture between competing corponation factions, since antagonizing any major shipper would be commercially self-defeating. Privately, Ferrogate's leadership has cultivated deep ties with KELPLINE LOGISTICS and STONEPATH LOGISTICS, the two primary freight handlers that depend on Ferrogate rails — relationships that function more like tributary arrangements than partnerships.
full_text: Ferrogate Transit Sovereign Corponation — stock designation FGTE-TR — is the physical backbone of the Meridian 88 corridor, owning and operating the 1,400-kilometer sovereign right-of-way network that threads hypervelocity freight and passenger rail through the megacity from Milwaukee to Cleveland.
